messages:
emily: spotted a bucket with old partner logs that include KMS ciphertext fragments and partner SA emails. unsure if any plaintext leaked.

raj: are the objects full ciphertexts or partial blobs? any KMS key names shown?

emily: full .cipher files + metadata. key shown: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/partner-keys/cryptoKeys/ingest-key. partner SA partner-ingest@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com.

sofia: if the SA had decrypt perms we need to assume exposure until proven otherwise. add to SIEM and create an incident.

sec-bot: INCIDENT LOGGED: sec-2024-1748881234  severity: medium  owner: @raj

raj: immediate plan: 1) revoke partner grant 2) copy objects to immutable archive 3) rewrap to new key 4) scan logs for decrypt ops 5) rotate any linked secrets.

dan: on the revoke: run
```
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding \\
  projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/partner-keys/cryptoKeys/ingest-key \\
  --member=serviceAccount:partner-ingest@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \\
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```

emily: done, revoke returned success and wrote the audit entry to ops logs.

sofia: SIEM: search for protoPayload.methodName = "google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" and principalEmail = partner-ingest@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com over last 180d.

raj: SIEM returned 3 decrypt events in 2024-05. escalating severity to P1. informing legal.

dan: archive step executed: copied objects to gs://sec-archive/incidents/1748881234/immutable/ with retention 2y.

emily: starting rewrap to our new key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/secure-rotations/cryptoKeys/ingest-key-v2. using ephemeral VM to avoid exposing blobs in prod.

sofia: also note: our audit sink lost storage.write perms last week during an RBAC cleanup. i regranted serviceAccount:sink@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com -> roles/storage.objectCreator and kicked backlog retrieval.

sec-bot: AUDIT BACKFILL: 214 events re-ingested into SIEM.

raj: discovered downstream Vault secrets referencing the old ciphertext path. will create new secret versions pointing to rewrapped blobs and mark old versions deprecated.

dan: add org policy to block cross-project cryptoKey grants to that key ring while we finish the review.

sofia: partner notification draft ready. include timeline, steps we took (revoke, archive, rewrap), and offer joint review. legal wants retention tag applied to the archive (7y flag).

emily: status summary: partner grant revoked, archive copied, rewrap started, SIEM confirms decrypts -> P1, legal looped, vault secret updates planned.

raj: owning final rotation, will post when vault updates and rewrap complete. ping @sofia @dan once done. :white_check_mark:
